decisions: NEW-1 (analyze.json): OPFS keyed per profile, following plan g1 over the task-000 split's F6 wording; 016 g6 still wipes it on sign out.

NEW-2 (analyze.json): installed pdfjs-dist ^6.3.289 and konva ^10.6.0 at latest; pinned react-konva to ^19.2.3 (not latest 19.3.0) because that version's peer range is react@^19.3.0 and the project pins react@19.2.8. No peer forced, React left unchanged. npm audit: 0 vulnerabilities.

Zoom bounds (0.5-4) are a default the docs do not pin; moved to shared/utils/zoom-bounds.ts (not a features/ import) so both the viewport slice and the page-stage leaf read the same constant without an I3 layering violation. Flagged for a check against the pilot tablet once Q8 is answered.

Committed zoom lives in the viewport slice (persisted); a pinch/pan gesture in flight is DOM-transient, applied as a CSS transform via a ref inside use-page-stage.ts, and only the final scale reaches Redux on the last pointer's pointerup — never through React state, per 03 §5.

page-stage has hasPainter: false in the blueprint; z2 is an empty Konva Stage/Layer host only. No *.painter.ts was added for this task — highlight-layer (010) and marquee (011) will draw into this Stage.
shared/lib/pdf.ts also owns the Storage download (downloadArtifact) and the per-profile OPFS load (loadArtifactBytes), keeping pdfjs-dist and the cache behind one seam per the placement tree.
document-viewer.tsx dynamic-imports the page-stage leaf with ssr: false (Next 16 lazy-loading guide), since react-konva touches window at import.
